ACCESSING,84a5ba82-f946-415a-b55f-8f2c8836fbb5,Secret Box Success Modal,Check access condition,Authorized user only,Entitled to open Secret Boxes,,User is (or is not) logged in; entitlement and unopened Secret Boxes vary.,"1. Entitled/logged-in user with unopened Secret Boxes
2. Logged-in user without entitlement
3. Unauthenticated user
4. Entitled/logged-in user with 0 unopened Secret Boxes","1. Attempt to open the Secret Box Success Modal as an entitled and logged-in user with unopened Secret Boxes.
2. Attempt as a logged-in user without entitlement.
3. Attempt as an unauthenticated user.
4. Attempt as an entitled and logged-in user with 0 unopened Secret Boxes.","1. The modal opens only for entitled, logged-in users with unopened Secret Boxes.
2. The modal does not open; access is denied, unavailable, or the user is redirected.
3. The modal does not open; access is denied, unavailable, or the user is redirected.
4. The modal does not open; access is denied, unavailable, or the user is redirected.",,,Access control and security,,,,
GUI,1f381999-24ce-4d42-881e-b2abdae2ece5,Secret Box Success Modal,Check layout,Modal title,Visibility and position,,The Secret Box Success Modal is open on various devices.,,"1. Open the modal on desktop and mobile devices.
2. Observe the title area.
3. Check the visual alignment and ensure nothing overlaps the title.
4. Resize the window or rotate the device orientation.","1. ---
2. The modal's title is centered at the top, fully visible, and matches the Spec ('MỞ SECRET BOX THÀNH CÔNG').
3. The title is not overlapped or cut off on any device.
4. The title remains centered and visible across different screen sizes.",,,User interface,,,,
GUI,d9d6e01a-7310-4643-a90e-a4fc89bc97d9,Secret Box Success Modal,Check layout,Instructional text,Display condition,,The Secret Box Success Modal is open with varying numbers of unopened boxes.,"1. Unopened box count > 0
2. Unopened box count = 0","1. Open the modal with unopened box count greater than 0.
2. Observe the instructional text area.
3. Open the modal with unopened box count equal to 0.
4. Observe the instructional text area.","1. ---
2. Instructional text is visible ('Click vào box để tiếp tục mở').
3. ---
4. Instructional text is hidden when unopened box count is 0.",,,User interface,,,,
GUI,dd842531-11c7-4a9b-8d14-037d3858f68a,Secret Box Success Modal,Check layout,Box image,Central position,,The Secret Box Success Modal is open with various screen sizes.,,"1. Open the modal with different screen resolutions.
2. Locate the box image ('C.Box image/Khung minh họa hộp quà mở').
3. Check its horizontal and vertical alignment.
4. Resize the browser window and/or rotate device.","1. ---
2. The box image is centered in the modal.
3. The aspect ratio is correct and there is no distortion.
4. The box image remains centered and proportioned on all screen sizes.",,,User interface,,,,
GUI,56da7ec8-5f02-450c-ada4-180ca35dbe55,Secret Box Success Modal,Check layout,Badge image,Visibility inside box image,,The modal is open after a box is opened.,"Each badge type: Stay Gold, Flow to Horizon, Beyond the Boundary, Root Further, Touch of Light, Revival","1. For each badge type, set the type as the reward and open the modal.
2. Observe the badge image displayed inside the box area.
3. Check that the badge is clear and visually distinct with no overlap or loss of detail.","1. ---
2. The correct badge image is displayed inside the box, clear and not obstructed.
3. All badge types are visually distinct without overlap or detail loss.",,,User interface,,,,
GUI,3a8ac6b5-e361-4f10-83d3-8316d28c5f5e,Secret Box Success Modal,Check layout,Unopened box counter,Label and number display,,Modal is open and there are unopened boxes (>0).,,"1. Open the modal.
2. Look at the bottom of the modal to locate the unopened box counter label and number.
3. Try to interact with the label/number area.","1. ---
2. The label 'Secretbox chưa mở' (small, white) and the unopened box count (large, bold, yellow) are visible and styled correctly. The label text displays as 'Secretbox chưa mở' (Secretbox chưa mở).
3. The counter area is not interactive—no focus or cursor appears.",,,User interface,,,,
GUI,632c600b-fcb8-47c6-b41b-5d86d9912e77,Secret Box Success Modal,Check layout,Modal close button,Position and visibility,,Modal is open on all device sizes.,,"1. Open the modal on desktop and mobile devices.
2. Locate the close button ('X') at the top right.
3. Check that the button is always visible.
4. Verify that nothing obstructs the close button.","1. ---
2. The close button is at the top right of the modal.
3. The button is clearly visible on all devices.
4. The close button is not obstructed by other UI elements.",,,User interface,,,,
GUI,a0cd2f27-67c0-4dc3-b781-5ef03ae9c2ed,Secret Box Success Modal,Initialize,Modal title,Correct static text,,The modal is opened after a box is triggered.,,"1. Open the modal.
2. Observe the title at the top of the modal.","1. ---
2. The modal displays the exact static text: 'MỞ SECRET BOX THÀNH CÔNG' (MỞ SECRET BOX THÀNH CÔNG).",,,User interface,,,,
GUI,a891383a-cbc3-496f-b1e1-aad4b8077db3,Secret Box Success Modal,Initialize,Instructional text,Conditional display on unopened boxes,,The modal is open; unopened boxes > 0.,,"1. Open the modal with unopened box count greater than 0.
2. Observe the instructional text area.","1. ---
2. The instructional text 'Click vào box để tiếp tục mở' (Click vào box để tiếp tục mở) is displayed.",,,User interface,,,,
GUI,4bbf0b67-deee-47a5-b9cb-afd22deb9421,Secret Box Success Modal,Initialize,Box image,Initial badge display,,Modal is open after a box is opened with a valid badge assigned.,,"1. Open the modal immediately after receiving a badge.
2. Observe the box image area.","1. ---
2. The correct badge image for the assigned badge is displayed inside the box illustration.",,,User interface,,,,
GUI,ce44f5ed-3a65-4b92-b61c-702fd02c8d41,Secret Box Success Modal,Initialize,Unopened box counter,Current box count value,,The modal is open with various unopened box counts from the backend.,0; 1; 4; maximum allowed value,"1. Open the modal with different numbers of unopened Secret Boxes.
2. Observe the unopened box counter area.","1. ---
2. The label displays 'Secretbox chưa mở' (Secretbox chưa mở), and the number accurately reflects the value from the backend without truncation.",,,User interface,,,,
FUNCTION,7c3c912f-21f1-4554-ab7f-cdded3938219,Secret Box Success Modal,Check component interaction,Box image,Click enabled if unopened boxes > 0,,Modal is open; unopened box count > 0.,,1. Click on the box image when unopened box count is greater than 0.,"1. A random badge is assigned, unopened box count decreases by 1, and the modal refreshes to display the new badge.",,,Normal_Others,,,,
FUNCTION,2a8a63de-c7cc-4e0e-b7db-33f049117b4c,Secret Box Success Modal,Check component interaction,Box image,Click disabled if unopened boxes = 0,,Modal is open; unopened box count = 0.,,1. Attempt to click on the box image when unopened box count is zero.,1. Clicking the box image has no effect; the box area is disabled when unopened box count is 0.,,,Normal_Others,,,,
FUNCTION,982ae7f9-dcd8-4954-b82c-e93f22cda5b1,Secret Box Success Modal,Check component interaction,Modal close button,On click closes modal,,The Secret Box Success Modal is open.,,1. Click the close ('X') button at the top right of the modal.,1. The modal closes when the close button is clicked.,,,Normal_Others,,,,
FUNCTION,d566fbeb-804b-42e5-8ce2-adfcfaf77346,Secret Box Success Modal,Check business logic,Badge selection,Random badge probabilities,,User is entitled with unopened boxes available.,Open boxes multiple times to gather badge distribution data.,"1. Open Secret Boxes repeatedly (e.g., 100 times).
2. Record the assigned badge for each attempt.","1. The assignment frequency aligns with the defined probabilities: Stay Gold (30%), Flow to Horizon (25%), Beyond the Boundary (10%), Root Further (5%), Touch of Light (20%), Revival (10%).
2. Only one random badge is assigned per box opening.",,,Normal_Others,,,,
FUNCTION,96fb45e8-2c42-48a9-8ebb-4eb369d20880,Secret Box Success Modal,Check data validation,Unopened box counter,Correct box count from backend,,Open modal after a box is opened.,0; 1; 4; maximum allowed value,"1. Open the modal with various backend values for unopened boxes.
2. Observe the box counter and verify displayed values.","1. The label 'Secretbox chưa mở' (Secretbox chưa mở) and the unopened box count always reflect the actual backend value, formatted without truncation.",,,Normal_Others,,,,
FUNCTION,43badf5d-01ff-46eb-9348-2c60b9041a41,Secret Box Success Modal,Check data validation,Badge display data,Valid badge ID/image only,,Inject invalid or corrupt badge data into the modal.,"1. Corrupt badge image
2. Missing badge data
3. Invalid badge ID","1. Open the modal with corrupt or missing badge image data.
2. Open the modal with an invalid badge ID.
3. Attempt script injection in the badge ID.","1. A fallback/default image is displayed for invalid badge data.
2. The modal does not show any error or crash for invalid badge ID.
3. Script tags or injections are not executed; no vulnerabilities are present.",,,Abnormal_Others,,,,
FUNCTION,5cc072ad-1453-453c-a743-7f03060ca00f,Secret Box Success Modal,Check security,Unopened box counter,Secured data source,,User is on the modal; attempt to modify unopened box count on client-side.,Attempt to manipulate unopened box count via JavaScript or dev tools.,"1. Change the unopened box counter via client-side manipulation.
2. Refresh or re-open the modal.",1. The unopened box count always resets to the correct backend value; client-side changes are ignored.,,,Security,,,,
FUNCTION,2e7bec78-b03e-4218-be22-0bd5ef858b0e,Secret Box Success Modal,Check security,Badge display data,No client-side manipulation,,User has opened the modal.,Attempt to modify the badge image URL using browser dev tools.,"1. Manipulate the badge image URL in the DOM or network requests.
2. Refresh or trigger the modal to reload the badge.","1. Only valid badge images are displayed; invalid or injected images do not appear, preventing unauthorized badge images or XSS/injection.",,,Security,,,,"}
